title: Islamic Finance Journey
description: A practical learning path covering the principles and applications of Islamic finance. From understanding the prohibition of Riba and the fundamentals of Shariah-compliant banking, to managing zakat on business wealth, halal investing, and Islamic inheritance planning. This roadmap equips learners with the knowledge to make ethical financial decisions in accordance with Islamic law.

courses.note: Core principles of Islamic finance including Riba and Gharar prohibitions
Understanding zakat obligations for business owners and wealth holders
Practical guidance on Shariah-compliant investment strategies
Applying Quranic inheritance laws to modern financial planning
